title: DoT survives boot; service checker matches the machine
objective: stunnel-dot.service must be active after every boot without manual restarts, dnsmasq must not form an ordering cycle with network-online.target, and check_and_enable_services.sh must neither check the removed pc_startup feature nor resolve extracted repos at stale ~/<repo> paths.
acceptance_criteria: Generated dnsmasq conf uses bind-dynamic and the drop-in has no network-online ordering (test_dns_units.sh)
Generated stunnel-dot.service has Wants=dnsmasq.service and no Requires=dnsmasq (test_dot_resolver_install.sh)
No startup_monitor references remain; the services suites pass at the coverage ratchet
Host: stunnel-dot active and serving TLS on 10.8.0.1:853
out_of_scope: Applying compulsive-block wrappers or LeechBlock (guard warnings left for the owner)
verifier: pre-commit (shell-coverage-ratchet in the namespace jail), vmbox behaviour check, setup_dot_resolver.sh --check on the host
